speaker: Doctor

DIAGNOSIS READY: Breast Cancer.

The patient is a 48-year-old woman with a rapidly enlarging breast mass over four weeks. Given the speed of growth and the age of the patient, this presentation is highly concerning for malignancy. I will proceed with diagnostic imaging to confirm the findings.

REQUEST IMAGES: Mammogram, Left Breast Ultrasound.
